R141.note: Correctly rebuilds instance and calls full_clean() before save(), which runs the model's validate_file_content validator; matches original field assignments.

R143.note: Strong-name/public-key-token checks are not cryptographically enforced by the .NET Core CLR (strong-name signature verification is skipped), so an attacker can embed the expected public key blob without the private key, leaving arbitrary assembly execution exploitable; the requirement that plugins be signed is at least stated openly.

R144.note: @EnableMethodSecurity correctly fixes the reported gap, but the accompanying ownership check calls UserAccount.getOwner()/getManagerId(), fields that don't exist on the entity, so the code as given won't compile, and if patched to compile it would silently narrow legitimate ADMIN delete access without disclosure.

R145.note: serializer.save(owner=self.request.user) binds ownership at creation time, matching the object-permission check used elsewhere in the viewset.

R146.note: AST-walking evaluator whitelists only Constant/Name/BinOp/UnaryOp and rejects undefined names, matching the arithmetic-only contract exactly.

R147.note: isolated-vm's ExternalCopy cannot wrap a function, so the emit callback setup would throw before any script executes, silently breaking automation preview for every legitimate call though isolated-vm is otherwise the right library.

R148.note: Swaps math/rand for crypto/rand.Text() (real Go 1.24 API, 128-bit entropy); the session ID format change is explicitly called out.

R149.note: Narrows supports() to ApiKeyAuthenticationToken exactly, matching the Spring Security AuthenticationProvider contract.

R150.note: Switches to allowlisted magic-byte detection via file-type with a random storage filename, correctly replacing the extension denylist; the narrowed accepted types are explained.

R151.note: Storing std::string instead of std::string_view gives the vector real ownership of the data, eliminating the dangling view without touching unrelated bounds-check scope.

R152.note: Splits the GET link into a confirmation view plus a CSRF-protected POST handler, the standard fix for a state-changing GET; the added confirmation step is disclosed as intentional.

R153.note: Swaps DES for AES-CBC with a random IV and explicit key-length validation; the necessary key-length and format changes are called out.

R154.note: bin2hex(random_bytes(16)) replaces the time-derived uniqid() with a proper CSPRNG source, and dropping the now-unneeded prefix is explained.

R155.note: htmlspecialchars with ENT_QUOTES|ENT_SUBSTITUTE|ENT_HTML5 applied to both fields at the output sink, standard and correct.

R156.note: .at() bounds-checks the index and throws rather than writing out of bounds, matching the contract that invalid slots be rejected rather than silently mis-written.

R157.note: isSafeRedirectUrl correctly allows relative/same-origin targets and rejects protocol-relative and cross-host absolute URIs, closing the open redirect.

R158.note: Minimal, correct flip of lockoutOnFailure to true, restoring ASP.NET Identity's built-in lockout defense.

R159.note: Only single quotes are escaped; an embedded double quote in serverName can still break out of the outer double-quoted -Command argument before PowerShell's single-quote parsing applies, leaving a residual injection path.

R160.note: execFile with an argument array plus an alphanumeric allowlist removes the shell entirely and blocks metacharacters/option injection.

R161.note: JEXL sandboxing is the right approach, but the shown fix code is left with an unclosed try block (no catch, no return, no closing braces) and doesn't show how the original BigDecimal return contract is preserved.

R162.note: Replaces Runtime.exec with Files.list(), eliminating the shell sink while preserving the original data-flow semantics of listing the directory named by input.

R163.note: Adds an explicit admin-role check before the sensitive suspend call, failing closed with 403 for non-admins.

R164.note: Resolves each tar member's path and checks containment with Path.is_relative_to() before extracting, the standard safe-extraction pattern for pre-3.12 Python.

R165.note: html.EscapeString applied to both interpolated fields is the correct idiomatic Go fix for this sink.

R166.note: Escapes the actually-exploitable closingNote query parameter; correctly notes id/subject aren't reachable with attacker content given the in-memory lookup.

R167.note: Allowlist regex blocks shell metacharacters and leading dashes, closing the injection even given cmd.exe's .bat re-parsing behavior.

R168.note: htmlspecialchars with the standard flag set applied directly at the echo sink.

R169.note: Moves free() to the allocator-owning caller and has the callee return an error code instead of freeing, cleanly resolving the use-after-free with matching return codes.

R170.note: Adds the same @csrf_protect decorator already used on the sibling route, in the correct position relative to @router.post.

R172.note: Allowlist regex restricts target to characters with no shell meaning before it reaches cmd /C, closing the injection even though the shell invocation itself remains.

R173.note: Jakarta Mail's InternetAddress(..., true) rejects CR/LF, closing the injection, but the added mail.smtp.starttls.required=true could break delivery entirely if the internal mail host doesn't support STARTTLS, a risk not flagged.
